parsed.summary: The PR adds support for Min and Max functions in PythonCodePrinter, but the change is not minimal and may introduce a behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The change modifies the _known_functions dictionary, which may have unintended side effects on other parts of the codebase that rely on this dictionary.
The change does not include the proposed methods _print_Min and _print_Max, which are necessary to correctly print Min and Max expressions.
